prompt:
A minimalist recipe card illustration for an elderberry winter tincture. Flat-lay top-down view of a small amber glass dropper bottle (warm honey-amber tint, soft highlights) lying slightly off-center (upper left) on a bone #F7EFE2 surface, with a black rubber dropper bulb and a tiny white kraft label that reads simply 'Elderberry' in clean serif type. Scattered around: a small cluster of dried elderberries (deep wine-purple, slightly wrinkled) and one branch of elderflower-stage greenery (small white-cream florets). The composition breathes — at least half the image is clean empty bone-colored surface. No utensils, no saucers, no extra text, no liquid spills.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern illustration — flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradients. Glass bottle has gentle highlights, NOT painterly glints. NO watercolor bleeds, NO paper grain, NO sketchy lines. Soft winter morning light from upper left casts a faint shadow below the bottle. Feels seasonal, immune-boosting, harvest-ready. Recipe card thumbnail — subject must read at small sizes.
